releases.notes:
[Added]
- Support WaEnhancer-style `background-color: #old #new` color replacement, three-color `color-tint` states, `left`/`top`/`right`/`bottom` offsets and `rgb()`/`rgba()`/`#rgb` colors in custom theme CSS.
- Apply `change_dpi` from a theme's header comment when no DPI is set.

[Fixes]
- Load custom theme CSS from per-target-app settings instead of showing an unthemed WhatsApp in Per Target App mode.
- Keep themed backgrounds, images and visibility in place when WhatsApp rebinds a view, and match activity-scoped rules on activity subclasses.
- Match selector chains, `:nth-child` and widget types the same way as WaEnhancer themes expect.
- Reject invalid CSS in the editor with the same checks the theme engine applies.
- Keep double-tap reactions bound to the current message and conversation, preventing stale recycled views from reacting to the wrong message.

[Improvements]
- Rebuild the custom theme CSS engine around a precompiled view-id index, so themes no longer slow down scrolling.

Built from commit 1c5ae9f903c77c5b2325d64d14aabcf3f2cc8131

[Added]
- Add Spanish and Latin American Spanish resource inventories with missing-key, extra-key and translation-divergence diagnostics, plus strict-mode controls.

[Fixes]
- Honor explicitly hidden Updates navigation when Instagram-style status is enabled.
- Restrict LSPosed scope evidence to the current Android user and discard stale cached scope information when live scope reads are unavailable.
- Confirm manual seen-tick changes only after a successful save and retain the last confirmed selection when saving fails.
- Let bottom navigation grow beyond its 72 dp minimum for larger text while retaining the current two-line, ellipsized labels.
- Constrain dashboard hook-status labels and values so they do not compete for the same row space.
- Preserve live hook-status hints and refresh actions in the current dashboard.
- Keep online-presence dots positioned on the measured avatar rim, including right-to-left layouts and rows without a separate photo view.
- Isolate host resource identifier caches by app package to prevent a manager lookup from hiding the corresponding WhatsApp avatar view.
- Use API 24-compatible reflection parameter inspections in presence resolvers.
- Confirm profile-photo exports only after MediaStore acknowledges publication, and remove the newly created row when publication fails.
- Release owned bitmaps when rendering fails and restore admission when worker submission is rejected.
- Distinguish unavailable photos from gallery save errors.
- Handle proximity wake locks when Disable Proximity is enabled so voice-note playback does not request proximity-based screen-off.
- Reject empty default string inventories and optimized Python runs that disable duplicate-resource or regression assertions.
- Restore the complete Spanish and Latin American Spanish resource names for current WAEX interface, emoji settings, update channels and diagnostics.

Built from commit 6a990975585392fc24605e0c93cd08860f83868d

[Fixes]
- Wait for Ghost Mode, Freeze Last Seen and DND setting writes to succeed before restarting WhatsApp.
- Cancel restart callbacks owned by closed screens and report failed or already-pending setting changes.
- Preserve the current header and quick-action entry points while waiting for each selected setting change to be acknowledged.
- Apply explicitly confirmed per-contact call blocks when global call privacy uses its default mode, while respecting an explicit global opt-out.
- Resolve saved callers within the active app and profile without treating unmapped LIDs or display names as saved contacts.
- Keep Delete for Me message preservation active until the outer deletion finishes when another hooked deletion runs inside it.
- Scope WhatsApp restarts and root APK installation to the manager's current Android profile.
- Verify launch targets and root launch acknowledgements before treating a restart as complete; retain normal launch fallback when needed.
- Retain the current delegated restart flow and reject contradictory launch output that includes an error alongside a success acknowledgement.
- Use one-shot unstable provider clients for WAEX calls from WhatsApp, closing them after each attempt without retrying ambiguous failures.
- Keep target-specific preference namespaces out of other targets' IPC snapshots and reject target writes to manager-only settings.
- Resolve raw disk preferences once so resolved IPC values and restart state are not overwritten when rebuilding the preference cache.

Built from commit 34314396d8c0379f355b82af57b7020f781fea64

[Fixes]
- Remove private message identifiers from the Anti-Revoke native-render failure diagnostic while retaining the exception type.
- Preserve the previous custom emoji font when a replacement download is incomplete, invalid, or cannot be saved.
- Report 100% download progress only after the replacement font has been saved.
- Do not substitute the account owner's photo when the viewed contact's photo source is unavailable.
- Resolve conflicting navigation preferences in the affected universal and app-specific scopes before saving imported settings.
- Save the status selected when Download is tapped, even if playback advances before the background save starts.

[Improvements]
- Check cloud emoji filenames, download sources, font headers, and download sizes; keep valid packs visible when the catalog also contains invalid entries.
- Update interface-scale regression checks to cover all six spacing tokens from the redesigned settings layout.
- Restore the utility imports needed to compile manual-read receipt retry regression fixtures.
- Refresh preserved-message dispatch test dependencies and strict fixtures for the current Java and Kotlin contracts.
- Restore revoke SQLite regression fixtures to compile the production row-ID predicate and reject missing or overly permissive patterns.
- Update runtime-framework test staging to stop copying the retired observation clock source.
- Update scoped-string preference fixtures to compile the production exclusivity helper and fail on unexpected diagnostic writes.

Built from commit 920df51e0a2b049035417e64c0a96dbb3af978b3
